subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) It was held on the first August 1971 at the Madison Square Garden, New York. (b) At the same time it raised millions of dollars for UNICEF relief fund. (c) He was an English singer who played a very important role in favour of Bangladesh during 1971. (d) The concert won huge support for the millions of war victims of Bangladesh. (e) It was arranged by George Harrison with the help of some other famous musicians. (f) It was organized to make the world aware of the sufferings of Bangladesh during the Liberation war. SSC English (g) Many of you have heard about the historic 'Concert for Bangladesh'. (h) About forty thousand people enjoyed this live concert. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (g) + (a) + (e) + (c)+ (f) + (h) + (d) + (b) Section B : Writing Test
